title: Best Addons module contract
description: The per-folder description read by build/extract.mjs. One contract per module; every other fact is derived, never declared twice.

$schema.description: Editor-only pointer to this file. Ignored by the extractor.

id.description: kebab-case, unique plugin-wide. Becomes the Elementor widget name suffix, the asset handles, the dist filenames, and the options-panel toggle key.

slug.description: The Elementor/Gutenberg category slug to register under. Required for type=category, ignored otherwise. Must differ from `id`: `id` names the folder and the manifest entry, `slug` names the thing a widget's get_categories() returns, and the two are free to change independently.

type.description: Which registrar claims this module. Adding a surface means adding a value here and a matching registrar.

tier.description: free always loads. pro is dropped by ProGate unless a license is active.

title.description: Human label. Shown in the Elementor panel and the options panel.

description.description: One line of prose for the options panel and panel search.

keywords.description: Feeds the Elementor panel's search box and the options panel filter.

version.description: Author-facing version. Diagnostics only — cache-busting uses the content hash.

entry.description: The PHP class file, relative to the module folder. Its class must match the folder-derived namespace.

category.description: Elementor category slug. Required for type=widget. Must be declared by some type=category module.

assets.description: Source files, relative to the module folder. Each becomes one Vite entry and one WordPress handle. Output paths and handles are derived, never written here.

editor.description: Elementor-editor-only behaviour. Never enqueued on the front end.
